svg.title: The KV cache turns “redo everything” into “add one row”
svg.desc: Two panels for the prompt Time, generating flies then fast. Without a cache, each step recomputes keys and values for every token so far, and the repeated work is shaded red: 6 token computations in three steps. With a cache, keys and values for earlier tokens are read from the cache and only the newest token gets a fresh query, key and value: 3 computations.
svg.text: The KV cache turns “redo everything” into “add one row”

g.text: Tokens projected to K and V: 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
grows with the square of the length
Tokens projected to K and V: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
grows in step with the length
recomputed, same result as last step

svg.text: Example from Raschka, “Understanding and Coding the KV Cache in LLMs from Scratch” (2025). Adapted from his figure.
